name: recursion
source:
---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals
RECURSIVE Sum(_), _ @@ _
Sum(n) == IF n = 0 THEN 0 ELSE n + Sum(n - 1)
a @@ b == a + b
Factorial[n \in Nat] == IF n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE n * Factorial[n - 1]
L == LET RECURSIVE F(_) F(n) == IF n = 0 THEN 0 ELSE F(n - 1) IN F(2)
====

name: cases
source:

Apply(F(_), a) == F(a)

D == Apply(LAMBDA n : n + 1, 2)

name: updates

name: instances
source:
---- MODULE Root ----
EXTENDS Naturals
---- MODULE Inner ----
CONSTANT N
VARIABLE x
Foo == x + N
====
INSTANCE Inner WITH N <- 1
LOCAL INSTANCE Inner WITH N <- 2
I(v) == INSTANCE Inner WITH x <- v, N <- 3
Z == LET J == INSTANCE Inner WITH N <- 4 IN J!Foo
====

name: counter
source:
---- MODULE Counter ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC
VARIABLE x
Init == x = 0
Next == x' = x + 1
Small == x < 3
====

name: ranges
source:
---- MODULE Ranges ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC
VARIABLE x
Init == x = 0
Next == x' = x
IfError == IF x THEN 1 ELSE 2
DomainError == DOMAIN x
FieldError == f.c
AndError == /\ x = 0
            /\ x
InfixError == (x + 1) \cup {2}
Paren == (x = 0)
====

name: precedence
source:

CONSTANTS P(_), C
VARIABLES x, y
F(a, b) == a + b * 2
G == ~(x = 0) => y \in {1, 2}
H == <<x, y>>
J == F(x,y)
K == f[x, y]
L == x /\ y /\ C
====

name: quantifiers
source:

Q == \A x, y \in S, z \in T : x = z
